brief.en: Shrinks zombies and makes them weaker

description.en: Shrinking Violets shrinks zombies in an area, forcing them to take double damage and reducing the bite damage they inflict.
description.zh: 畏缩紫罗兰将范围内僵尸缩小，减少他们的啃咬速度，使他们承受两倍的攻击。

chat.en: Shrinking Violet started out shy, but it's remarkable how a discovering a magical talent for zombie-reduction can change your whole outlook.
chat.zh: 畏缩紫罗兰一开始很害羞，但当她发现自己在减少僵尸方面的神奇才能后，她的整个观念都发生了巨大的变化。

text.zh: 一次性使用，接触到僵尸时触发
缩小周围格子范围内的所有僵尸
使小鬼僵尸缩小至消失
